# Ibn Sina Hospital

> Official website information for Ibn Sina Hospital, a multi-specialty healthcare facility located in Ompora, Budgam, Jammu and Kashmir, India.

## Official Hospital Information

- Name: Ibn Sina Hospital
- Category: Multi-specialty hospital
- Location: Ompora, Budgam, Jammu and Kashmir, India
- Address: Near Railway Station, Ompora Railway Station Road, Ompora, Budgam, Jammu & Kashmir 191111, India
- Website: https://ibnsinahospital.in/
- Telephone: +91 9622552553
- Alternate Telephone: +91 9419023501
- Email: weibnsina@gmail.com

For current operating hours, specialist schedules and service availability, consult the official website or contact the hospital directly.

## Medical Services Listed on the Website

The hospital's website describes the following services:

- Emergency and ambulance services
- Pharmacy
- Diagnostic laboratory
- Dialysis
- Endoscopy and colonoscopy
- Treadmill testing (TMT)
- Holter monitoring
- Ambulatory blood pressure monitoring (ABPM)
- Digital X-ray and ultrasound
- Physiotherapy
- Sigmoidoscopy
- Vaccination services

Service availability, hours, equipment and appointment requirements should be confirmed with the hospital.

## Medical Departments Listed on the Website

- Cardiology
- Orthopaedics
- Gynaecology
- Paediatrics

- Dermatology

- Nephrology
- Radiology
- General Surgery
- Plastic Surgery
- Pulmonology
- Rheumatology

- Ophthalmology
- Physiotherapy

- Psychiatry

Department listings do not establish that every specialist or service is available at all times.
